neighbours.label: The token right after a copula or conditional that holds the predication open: ' not' after 'is/was', and ' it' after conditional 'if' or an inverted question 'is'; the same 'is'/'if' followed by any other word stays quiet.
fire: For a budget hotel, the breakfast here is not terrible at all.
Tell me honestly, is it worth paying extra for the window seat?
If it snows overnight, the school will open two hours late.

If it works on the test server, we will deploy it on Monday.
Doctor, is it safe to fly two weeks after the operation?
If it be your will, my lord, I shall ride at dawn.
The second-hand bike was not expensive, and it rides well.
